description: Off-by-one error on the shared input buffer boundary check: using > 0 instead of >= 0, causing a shared buffer with _inputStart == 0 to be ignored.
Swapped comparison operator: checking if _resultArray is null instead of not-null.
Missing assignment side-effect when returning the converted result string as a char array, failing to cache it in _resultArray.
Wrong logical operator on the single-segment check: using logical OR instead of logical AND, returning the current segment incorrectly even when segments have been split/allocated.
Wrong variable name used in the single segment check: checking _inputBuffer instead of _currentSegment.
